capacity.sourceNote: Published as a 20- or 30-round detachable box magazine, from the infobox, uncited there. The weapon was designed around a dedicated subsonic 7.62x25mm Type 64 cartridge not carried on this site, but the article states standard 7.62x25mm Tokarev ammunition also functions in it, at the cost of faster wear on its integral suppressor.
